steps.note: S1.3.1.1.1 states rows 0-1 subtract, rows 2-5 add, rows 6-7 restore the scratch vectors, so the net target change is (JV+RG)x for any scratch values a,c, matching the paper.
S1.3.1.1.2 gives the bit-network central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one neighbors, and self coefficient 1.
S1.3.1.1.2 gives the complex-network central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 with side injection cancelling intersections zero and two, and self coefficient 1.
S1.3.1.1.3 states the inverse schedule gives X<-X-Y and the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), each invocation restoring its scratch wires.

The plan says every edge joins nested labels and that the other edges split along A=B+P, F=<t>+t^perp, but never gives the per-edge residual table with its dimensions; only the center 3->4 loss and the side 2->5 residual appear.
S1.3.1.3.4 states <t_X> inside t_Y^perp for neighbors (from orthogonal neighboring triple lines in S1.3.1.3.1) with residual P tensor <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2.
Only center 3->4 decreases, losing P tensor F of dimension h (S1.3.1.3.3, .5); telescoping gives sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N (S1.3.1.4) and absolute Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich (S1.3.1.5).
S1.3.3.3 only asserts that every nonzero binary residual has an orthonormal basis; the plan never states nondegeneracy, nonalternation or the absorption of alternating planes that derive it.
S1.3.1.6 states L/N = 100/539 for the bit network and 101/539 for the complex network, both below 1/2.
S1.3.3.1 gives the weight formula, additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, and q_V-q_U = sum over an orthonormal basis of wt(v)[v.x], negated on a decreasing edge.
S1.3.3.2 states odd weight, the phase i^(eps[v.x]) as (1+i^eps)/2+(1-i^eps)/2 (-1)^(v.x), and H diag(1,-1) H = X giving aI+bX_v or its inverse.

The phase-network steps (S1.3.3, S1.3.3.3) count the kernels as s_c but never state that on k columns each residual vector gives one k-fold tensored factor; S1.5.1/S1.5.2 say this only for child calls on f chunks in the layer, not as the interface step.
S1.3.3.4 gives frames I and C^(tensor m), C^-1 on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), repair by Z_{a,k} before and i^(27k) Z_{a,k} after via C=iZC^-1Z; S1.3.3.5 negates the physical X outputs.
L/N below 1/2 (S1.3.1.6) with deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 so s<Wm (S1.3.2.3, S1.3.3.3), and the S1.3.1 motivation ties L<N/2 to staying below Wm.
S1.3.4 states both deficits exceed 20*2^-50, log m<20 gives m^(1-2^-50) > m(1-eta), hence s/W<m^tau and m^sigma with tau=sigma=1-2^-50.

S1.4.1.1 gives A=E_1 Pi E_2 with lower-triangular E's by repeatedly eliminating around the rightmost nonzero entry of the topmost nonzero row, with Pi having exactly a ones; the elimination is stated tersely but with the pivot rule and repetition.

S1.4.1's claim only names a fixed odd prime avoiding the denominators of the factorization; the finite table of factors and the specialization to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors are not stated.
S1.4.1.2 states a lower-triangular change costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order, each a unit multiple plus earlier coordinates still holding original values.
S1.4.1.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j taking (h,d) to (h+d,d) with one interchange, so a ones cost a interchanges.
The plan only mentions Delta=ceil(C_0 d^C_1) and C_1 in S1.5.9; it never defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3} or C_0=128mB^2.
S1.5.9 asserts the depth bound C_0 d^C_1 without the recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, the leaf bound 8e or the per-invocation count below E; S1.5.7 is the time recurrence, not the arithmetic-depth one.
No unrolling B^(k+1)<=B^2 d^nu or A(e)<=8B^2 d^(nu+1) appears in the plan; only the final depth bound is asserted.

S1.5.9 states p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits and Delta=o(p) from epsilon C_1<1, but omits the depth-l statement (values in 2^-(p+l)Z[i], modulus at most 2^l) that makes the reservation exact.
S1.5.10 states each row of H_0^(tensor D) has absolute row sum one, so disk arrays map to disk arrays and the single final truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^-p.

summary: 18 of 26 sub-steps present. Plan carries the bank-exchange network fully (B1-B4), the label budget except the residual table and the orthonormal-basis derivation (L2, L3, L5 present; L1, L4 absent), the phase interface except the k-column tensoring (P1, P2, P4 present; P3 absent), all four rank-saving numeric steps (R1-R4), the matrix-shear elimination, cost and interchange steps but not the prime/table specialization (M1, M3, M4 present; M2 absent), and only the final disk step of the simultaneous layer (S5 present); the arithmetic-depth constants, recurrence, unrolling and depth-to-bits mechanism (S1-S4) are not derived in the plan.
